title: Example Film

story.logline: A courier must cross a flooded city before the last evacuation train leaves.
story.story_goal: Deliver the medicine and escape before dawn.

world_rules: Water obeys realistic mass, drag, and buoyancy.
Technology is contemporary and visibly weathered.

visual_worlds.palette: cool blue-grey with warm emergency-light accents

characters.performance_profile: Contained urgency; she masks fear by solving practical problems.
characters.voice_lock: Low mezzo, clipped phrasing under stress, never theatrical.

locations.geography: Entrance south, ticket hall center, platforms north, service stairs east.
locations.light_lock: Pre-dawn blue through broken roof; amber emergency fixtures.

assets.continuity_lock: Silver hard case, black handle, red medical seal intact until scene 08.

audio_policy.dialogue: Generate performance dialogue in-shot when model capability is verified.
audio_policy.music: Use post-score by default; native source music only when it drives visible timing.
audio_policy.ambience: Rain, distant alarms, water movement, structural creaks.
audio_policy.subtitle_policy: No generated subtitles or on-screen text.

model_adapters.notes: Re-verify live limits before a costly production batch.
